compressed_items.content: Standing-pure indexed purpose view preserving both the graph-theoretic-criterion subtitle and abstract purpose: distinguish autonomous self-modification from proposed open-ended evolution through causal access to future-revision machinery.

content.E_star: external reality/environmental or ecological causal influence
content.C_rev: constitutional revision mechanism determining generation of future revision rules

compressed_items.content: P_C is defined as E* having directed causal reachability to C_rev. This is the source permeability definition/formal relation, not an empirical result.
Source states Delta C_rev != 0 does not imply P_C; revision/change alone is formally separated from permeability.
Closure-side formal condition is E* not directed-reachable C_rev.

Central necessary-condition family: open-endedness is proposed to require external reality retaining causal access to constitutional revision; preserving P_C is not projected as a sufficient condition by the compressor.

Source proposes that purely internally generated constitutional revision can support learning/optimization/self-redesign while remaining bounded by internally generated rules or fixed future-possibility topology.
Source proposes that closed trajectories and open lineages can be distinguished through causal topology rather than continual change, behavior or semantics.

Conceptual interpretations include reality retaining causal access, external reality participating rather than merely being observed, open-endedness not being continual change, and the one-line 'reality can rewrite what rewriting means' compression.

Source labels existence of a graph cut separating E* from C_rev as equivalent to no directed reachability. The compression preserves the source equivalence assertion without upgrading it to independently proved equivalence.

Predictions: severed permeability yields closure; preserved permeability yields greater long-term adaptive capacity than internal self-modification alone; otherwise similar systems should diverge under sufficiently novel environments when only one preserves constitutional permeability.
CPP would be challenged by sustained open-ended evolution with no external-reality-to-C_rev causal pathway while future possibility space continues expanding indefinitely.

Source characterizes CPP as a graph-theoretic criterion/invariant. These labels are preserved as source characterization and do not themselves establish a proved invariance theorem or universal scientific law.
